edges.description: The constitutively active receptor engages the Ras-MAPK/ERK cascade as its principal effector arm in growth-plate chondrocytes.
Beyond the growth plate, the same allele alters osteoblast and osteocyte function, producing the mineralization defect that gives the entry its bone-quality arm.
A separate consequence arm acting on the cranial base rather than the limb growth plate, and the origin of the foramen magnum and macrocephaly features.
Sustained MAPK/ERK signalling suppresses chondrocyte proliferation and differentiation in the growth plate, which is what impairs endochondral bone formation and shortens the long bones.
